result.summary: The page is generally functional and well-structured. One minor visual issue was identified related to a discount badge displaying inconsistent/unusual content.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card at the bottom shows '-0%', which is a meaningless or erroneous discount value. A 0% discount is not a real discount and looks like a data/formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Only show a discount badge when the discount value is greater than 0%. Add a conditional check to hide the badge when the discount is 0 or null.
